tei:div.tei:p: rdzogs chen don gyi gsol 'debs phun tshogs dpal 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sku gsum dag pa'i zhing khams su// byin rlabs dngos grub phun sum tshogs// rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// dur khrod chen po'i gnas mchog tu// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub brnyes// rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// dngos grub 'byung ba'i sgrub gnas su// rang gzhan don gnyis phun sum tshogs// gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su// thams cad sku dang ye shes dang*// yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// gnas dang nye ba'i zhing khams su// dngos grub yid bzhin char 'bebs pa'i// bde chen mkha' 'gro rigs lnga la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// rnam dag sgrub pa'i zhing khams su// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med// mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// gdaud nas dag pa chos kyi dbyings// 'gyur med rig pa'i klong yongs su// gnas rang snang 'od gsal 'og min la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// rang rig gdod nas sangs rgyas la// sku dang ye shes lhun gyis grub// ston pa ye nas phun tshogs la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// cir snang rang byung ye shes ngang*// rang snang rig pa tshom bur bcas// 'khor kun ye nas lhun rdzogs la// gsaul ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// mnyam rdzogs byang chub sems kyi ngang*// ye nas lhun grub rgyu 'bras 'das// chos kun ye nas rdzogs chen la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// thams cad 'gyur med dag pa'i klong*// rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lo'i gzhi// dus bzhi rgyun gyi 'khor lo la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// cir snang sku dang ye shes dang*// grags stong skye med chos kyi sgra// dran rig ye nas sangs rgyas thugs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// rang snang rig pa'i klong chen 'dir// snang srid snod bcud rnam dag pas// 'khor ba ma spangs dong sprugs su// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// rang rig mkha' mnyam klong chen du// sku gsum ma btsal ye rdzogs pas// myang 'das ma sgrub lhun grub la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// chos kun byang chub sems kyi klong*// ma sbyangs ma bgrod lhun gyis grub// thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// rig pa ka dag chos sku'i klong*// zang thang rjen par gsol ba 'debs// rgya grol bar med phyal pa'i ngang*// rdzogs pa chen por byin gyis rlobs// ye shes lhun grub 'od gsal klong*// dbyings snang dag par byin gyis rlobs// 'char gzhi ma 'gags sprul pa'i klong*// gzung 'dzin dag par byin gyis rlobs// chos kun rang byung rig pa'i klong*// 'bad med yongs grol byin gyis rlobs// rgyu 'bras blang dor bya rtsol 'das// gzhi rdzogs chos skur byin gyis rlobs// thams cad mnyam rdzogs byang chub klong*// khams gsum yongs grol byin gyis rlobs// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la// rang gzhan don du gsol ba 'debs// dgongs pa chos nyid zad par skyol// don gnyis rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs// dbyings ka nas dag pa chos zad ngang*// blo 'das chos skur zang thal le// bka' brgyud bla mas byin gyis rlobs// rtsa ba'i bla mas thugs rjes zungs// rang snang 'od gsal longs sku'i zhing*// sku dang thig le me re re// bka' brgyud bla mas byin gyis rlobs// rtsa ba'i bla mas thugs rjes zungs// dbyings rig mkha' ltar dag pa'i klong*// 'od gsal rlung sems rnam dag tu// bka' brgyud bla mas byin gyis rlobs// rtsa ba'i bla mas thugs rjes zungs// thams cad zab mo'i chos nyid klong*// ci bsam yid bzhin lhun grub tu// bka' brgyud bla mas byin gyis rlobs// rtsa ba'i bla mas thugs rjes zungs// gsol 'debs chen mo sku gsum dag pa phun tshogs dpal 'bar zhes bya ba/

theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor ba rnams kyis gsol ba yang yang btab pa'i ngor/ lhun grub gling gi dben gnas su bkod pa rdzogs so// ༈ hūm̐/ chos dbyings ngang las sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs pa// dus gsum bla ma 'gro mgon thugs rje'i lha// zhi khro rab 'byams ye shes mkha' 'gro dang*// bka' bzhin rjes su sgrub pa'i las mdzad pa// dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod//
